name: Altea Aquila
original_name: アルテア・アクイーラ
source:
With her golden blond hair and sapphire blue eyes, Princess Altea is known across the land for her extraordinary beauty. However, to end the terrible drought that has ravaged her beloved Kingdom of Aquila, she is sacrificed to the sorcerer Aldebaran.

She soon discovers Aldebaran has implanted some sort of strange tentacles into her back...

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/jast039/sweet-sacrifices]Jast USA[/url] and [url=http://www.chaos-r.com/chaos-01.php]CHAOS-R[/url]]
